issues.issue: os.link then chmod changes old T2 inode permissions; seeding must not mutate old artifacts
issues.fix: copy2 then chmod only new copy, or symlink without chmod target; never overwrite an existing borrowed artifact except an owned invalid copy

issues.issue: borrow seeding trusts a static plan without live source/output/transitive provenance validation; skip BORROWED bypasses source/dep checks
issues.fix: before seed/skip recheck all borrowed current source hashes, original T2 hashes/state/context/audit IDs/output hashes against Root accepted snapshot; require every project dependency borrowed and unchanged; reject stale existing destination hash

issues.issue: inherited run() may enable optional mapped RSS6 on non-thin T1 root
issues.fix: this initial T1 lane uses default RSS4 everywhere; no --mapped-rss-gib flag before actual measured need and Root review
